entities.name: Query MurE ligase
observations: 505 aa bacterial enzyme; predicted molecular weight 54.27 kDa and theoretical pI 6.32.
Sequence contains Mur_ligase (PF01225), Mur_ligase_M (PF08245), and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875) domains.
Best reviewed homologs are MurE ligases with 45.2–50.8% identity and 91.7–98.2% query coverage, supporting functional transfer.
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent addition of meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate.
Likely cytoplasmic and involved in peptidoglycan biosynthesis, cell division, and bacterial cell-shape regulation.
Homolog annotations indicate Mg2+ dependence and ATP binding; exact substrate specificity remains homology-based rather than experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP yields UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:23676.
Reaction assignment is supported by multiple reviewed homologs and sequence/domain concordance.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE ligase activity supplies the meso-diaminopimelate-containing UDP-MurNAc pentapeptide precursor used in bacterial cell-wall assembly.
